import Mathlib

theorem p12 (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : StrictMono f) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ f n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ k ih =>
      exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt ih (hf (Nat.lt_succ_self k)))
reasoning: Not compiled — reasoned through by hand. Induction on n: base case is Nat.zero_le. In the step, ih : k ≤ f k and hf (Nat.lt_succ_self k) : f k < f (k+1), so lt_of_le_of_lt gives k < f (k+1), and Nat.succ_le_of_lt converts to k+1 ≤ f (k+1). Mathlib also has StrictMono.id_le proving this in one line, but the induction proof avoids depending on that lemma's name.
